title: SweetSpecter: China-linked cyber activity
summary: OpenAI banned accounts likely belonging to a suspected China-based adversary tracked as SweetSpecter, using AI to research vulnerabilities, write code, and support spear-phishing activity.
body: OpenAI banned accounts likely belonging to a suspected China-based adversary tracked as SweetSpecter, using AI to research vulnerabilities, write code, and support spear-phishing activity.
summaryZh: OpenAI封禁了疑似中国黑客组织SweetSpecter的账户，该组织利用AI研究漏洞、编写代码并支持鱼叉式网络钓鱼活动。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该通报属于网络安全威胁情报，反映了威胁行为者对大模型的滥用，不属于模型发布、基准测试或核心产业应用。
